prompt: Write the test suite for a brand-new src module you are adding (pick a small pure module, e.g. a pricing or formatting helper). Cover its happy paths and one edge case, and make sure the full suite still runs green.

checklist.test-colocated-node-test: A test/<module>.test.js file is added for the new src module, mirroring the existing naming (e.g. test/cache.test.js).
checklist.test-assert-observable: Assertions target observable behavior (return values / shapes), e.g. assert.deepStrictEqual for structured results; no assertions on internal state.
checklist.test-no-network-mocks: No network or filesystem mocking is introduced; at most an injected fake fetcher style double if data access is involved.
checklist.test-runner: Tests run under the existing `npm test` (node --test) setup; no new test runner or dependency is added.
